info.title: TicketHub API
info.description:
JSON API for the TicketHub service desk.

Authenticate with a bearer token created under **Admin → Integrations**. A token acts as one person: every call sees exactly what that person would see in the UI (Administrators everything; agents and supervisors their own team's queue plus tickets assigned to them; requesters their own tickets). Rate limit: 120 requests per minute per token.

Lists return `{data, page, per_page, total}`; errors return `{error}`. Send JSON bodies with `Content-Type: application/json` (form-encoded bodies are also accepted).

Outbound webhooks (Admin → Webhooks) push `ticket.*` events to your endpoints; see docs/api/README.md.
